spans.s:
The words भ्रातृ 'brother' and पुत्र 'son', when spoken of along with स्वसृ 'sister' and दुहितृ 'daughter' respectively are only retained and the latter are dropped.

Terms: भ्रातृ

The affix क्विप् comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. भ्राज 'to shine' 2. भास् 'to shine' 3. धुर्व 'to injure' 4. द्युत् 'to shine' 5. ऊर्ज 'to be strong' 6. पॄ 'to fill' 7. जु 'to move rapdily' 8. स्तु 'to praise', when preceded by the word ग्रवन् 'a stone'.

Terms: क्विप्

The affix व्यत् also comes in the sense of descendant after the word भ्रातृ।

Terms: व्यत्

When an elder brother is alive, the younger brother gets the title of युवन् , being the descendant of a grandson etc.

Terms: युवन्

In the room of र् and the penultimate letter स् of the root भ्रस्ज , there is optionally the substitute रम् when an आर्धधातुक affix follows.

Terms: आर्धधातुक changes

The shortening of the penultimate of the Causative अङ्ग (stem) in the reduplicated Aorist, is optional in the following - 1. भ्राज् 2. भास् 3. भाष् 4. दीप् 5. जीव् 6. मील् and 7. पीड् ।

Terms: Aorist shortening
